introLead: Built for advanced users who want full control. Connect triggers, conditions and actions into one system, then test every path before it reaches chat.
introDo: Thank them and change the lights
introAlertsBody: Thank follows, subs, cheers and raids
introTimersBody: Repeat a message while you're live
connectExisting: Connect to a step on the board
lightKeyBody: Connect your Govee account to choose a light. This also sets up the Govee module, so you won't be asked again.
lightKeyPath: Get a key in the Govee Home app: {path}
userFound: Found on Twitch. Still matches if they rename.
userMissing: No Twitch user with that name.
userFailed: Could not check that name. Try again.
userIdOnly: Showing the Twitch user ID because the name could not be looked up.
saveFailed: Could not save. Try again in a moment.
saveDenied: Recipes are available on Premium while in beta.
saveNotFound: This recipe no longer exists. It may have been deleted somewhere else.
staleBody: This recipe was saved from another tab or device after you opened it. Saving now replaces that version with yours.
toggleFailed: Could not change that recipe. Try again.
toggleStale: This recipe changed somewhere else. Showing the latest.
discardBody: This recipe has changes you have not saved.
deleteBody: This removes the recipe and stops it running. This cannot be undone.
deleteFailed: Could not delete. Try again in a moment.
deleteBuiltin: Built-in alerts cannot be deleted. Turn it off instead.
upgradeTitle: Turn this into a full recipe?
upgradeCommandBody: This command becomes a recipe with its own steps, and the command is removed.
upgradeAlertBody: This alert becomes a recipe with its own steps, and the built-in alert is turned off.
upgradeUses: The command's use count stops, and {count} and {uses} cannot be shown in a recipe.
upgradeLive: It only replied while you were live. Add a live check to keep that.
upgradeUser: It was limited to one user. Add a specific user step to keep that.
upgradeCounter: It bumped the {counter} counter. Add a counter step to keep that.
upgradeRepeat: The built-in alert skips repeats inside {hours} hours. A recipe does not.
upgradeResubs: Resubscriptions and sub messages are no longer covered.
warnAutomationsOff: Saved, but the Automations module is off, so this recipe will not run until you turn it on.
warnShadowed: A command with the same trigger answers first, so this recipe will not fire for it.
warnCommandDelete: Saved, but the old command could not be removed. It still answers first.
warnAutomationDelete: Saved, but an older copy of this recipe could not be removed.
warnAlertOff: Saved, but the built-in alert is still on, so viewers may see both.
warnAlertsOn: The Chat alerts module was off and is now on.
unsupportedTitle: This recipe can't open here yet
unsupportedBody: It uses a step the builder cannot draw. It keeps running, and you can edit it in Automations.

issue.noTrigger: Add a When step to start this recipe.
issue.multipleTriggers: A recipe can only start one way. Remove the extra When step.
issue.cycle: This step loops back on itself. Remove one of the connections.
issue.unconnectedNode: This step is not connected to the start. Connect it or remove it.
issue.unstructuredMerge: Two paths join here in a way that cannot be saved. Give each path its own steps.
issue.unsupportedNode: This step cannot be saved yet.
issue.unsupportedTrigger: This start cannot be saved yet.
issue.unsupportedCondition: This check cannot be saved yet.
issue.unsupportedAction: This action cannot be saved yet.
issue.waitTooLong: This wait is longer than a recipe can pause.
issue.unmappableToken: {token} is not available with this start. Remove it or change the start.
issue.userNotResolved: Pick a Twitch user. Type a name and leave the field so it can be checked.
issue.usesToken: {count} and {uses} only work in commands. Remove them to save this as a recipe.
issue.commandExists: A command with this trigger already exists.
issue.alertExists: That alert is already set up. Edit or turn it off first.
issue.duplicate: A recipe like this already exists.
issue.tooMany: You have reached the recipe limit.
issue.outOfRange: A number is outside the allowed range.
issue.invalidFormat: A value is not in the right format.
issue.delayBudget: The waits add up to more than a recipe can pause.
issue.name: Give the recipe a name using letters, numbers and spaces, up to 64 characters.
issue.generic: Something in this recipe cannot be saved ({code}).

choiceEmpty.rewards: No channel point rewards yet. Create one in Channel points.
choiceEmpty.counters: No counters yet. Create one in Counters.

choiceProblem.scenes: Could not load the scenes for this light.
choiceProblem.keyRejected: Govee did not accept your API key.

choiceMissing: "{name}" is no longer in the list.
